## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and any related issue.

## Validation

List checks run and their results. Explain checks that could not run.

## Compatibility and security

Describe breaking changes, migration steps, new dependencies, permission changes and security effects. Report undisclosed vulnerabilities privately before opening a public PR.

- [ ] I have authority to contribute the included work and have checked applicable repository contribution terms.
- [ ] I preserved required licenses and notices and identified new dependencies.
- [ ] I excluded secrets, customer data and private diagnostics.
- [ ] I updated documentation and added meaningful tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI assistance and reviewed the resulting changes.
